title: Insights into Criteria for Statistical Significance from Signal Detection Analysis
reproduction_verdict: Reproduces (near-exact). All load-bearing AUCs and the central p-value-Bayes-factor redundancy claim reproduce from the author's code (bit-identical equivalence).
key_caveat: Shipped optional-stopping script simulates 40 studies, not the 20 described.

title: Moral Licensing: A Replication Study (meta-analytic update)
reproduction_verdict: Partially reproduces. Overall effect d~0.27 and culture subgroups recover from raw data, but the packaged analysis cannot regenerate the k=76 headline tables and the reported I2 is internally inconsistent with the paper's own Q.
key_caveat: Headline sample size (k=76) and I2 do not reproduce from the archived meta-analytic data.

title: Bayesian Generalized Linear Mixed Models: Posterior Passing for False-Positive Control
reproduction_verdict: Reproduces (exact). All load-bearing figures reproduce exactly from the shipped result and the method is independently regenerated with a fixed seed.
key_caveat: False-positive claim verified against shipped result file, not re-simulated from scratch (seed-sensitive MCMC).

title: Type I Error Rates in Repeated-Measures ANOVA and Mixed-Model ANOVA: A Simulation Study
reproduction_verdict: Reproduces. Primary MLM-UN liberal-bias finding reproduces in direction and magnitude in independent R and Python; exact SAS/SPSS table cells are unverifiable.
key_caveat: MLM-UN Type I error claim not reproducible (R gives 35% vs prose ~5%); full S=5000 infeasible.

title: Graph Construction: An Empirical Investigation on Setting the Range of the Y-Axis
reproduction_verdict: Reproduces (near-exact). All sensitivity/bias means, t-tests, CIs, and effect sizes across all five experiments reproduce from open data in R and Python.
key_caveat: Author analysis script not runnable as distributed (hard-coded local path); '57 participants' count inconsistent.

title: Similar event-related potentials to music and language: A replication of Patel et al. (1998)
reproduction_verdict: Reproduces (near-exact). All pre-registered P600 ANOVAs and Bayes factors reproduce exactly; two appendix Bayes factors show Monte-Carlo noise.
key_caveat: Two appendix RATN Bayes-factor magnitudes ~3%/1.5% low (Monte-Carlo noise in BayesFactor).

title: The File-Drawer Report: A Pre-registered Study of the Reproducibility of Psychological Science
reproduction_verdict: Reproduces. Raw data and SPSS syntax retrieved from OSF; essentially every primary per-study statistic and the meta-analytic g~0 reproduce in R and Python.
key_caveat: Open data / open reproducible analysis claim not substantiated (OSF data component empty).
